## 1.0 Introduction

The goal of this project is to identify eoPRED score associations with sex chromosome DNA methylation. I will use two datasets of placentas. The '450K Dataset' will consist of publicly available 450K array placental datasets with preeclampsia cases. 

NOTE: When I first wrote these scripts I called the 450K Dataset the 'Discovery Cohort' and the SPAH Dataset the 'Validation Cohort'. You may still see objects named this way.

### 1.1 Packages

```{r packages, warning=F, message=F}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(minfi)
library(lumi)
library(planet)
library(EpiDISH)
library(ewastools)
library(wateRmelon)
library(ExperimentHub)
library(mixOmics)
library(ggrepel)

probeInfo_450k <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Locations, 
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Other, 
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Manifest))

probeInfo_450k$probeID <-rownames(probeInfo_450k)
chrXprobes <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (chr == "chrX") #11232
chrYprobes <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (chr == "chrY") #416
autoProbes <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (!(chr %in% c("chrX", "chrY"))) #473864

remove(probeInfo_450k)

set.seed(4815)

```

### 1.2 Data

Included datasets:

-   GSE100197 (n=102)
-   GSE103253 (n=82)
-   GSE125605 (n=42)
-   GSE75196 (n=24)
-   GSE98224 (n=48) 
-   GSE57767 (n=45)
-   GSE73375 (n=36) 
  
`complete_mset.rds` is the **raw** Mset methylation data from all of the aforementioned datasets downloaded from GEO.

```{r data}

iciar_data_path <- "//fs/teams/RobinsonLab/Icíar/Projects/Aim2_SexPE/Data/00_Raw/"

mset_all <- readRDS(paste0(iciar_data_path,"complete_mset.RDS"))
dim(mset_all) #485512 x 401

#get the phenotype data (pData)
pDat_all <- as.data.frame(pData(mset_all))
dim(pDat_all) #401 x 22

#filter metadata to the correct datasets
pDat_disc <- pDat_all %>%
  filter(GEO_Dataset %in% c("GSE100197", "GSE103253", "GSE125605", "GSE75196", "GSE98224", "GSE57767" ,"GSE73375"))
dim(pDat_disc) # 379

#filter the mset 
table(pDat_disc$Sample_ID %in% colnames(mset_all))
mset <- mset_all [,pDat_disc$Sample_ID]
dim(mset)

#load the snps
snps_all <- readRDS(paste0(iciar_data_path,"snps.RDS"))
dim(snps_all) #65 x 419
table(pDat_disc$Sample_ID %in% colnames(snps_all))

#it's missing the snps for datasets GSE120981 and GSE103253
#not available on GEO, I checked

```

## 2.0 Sample Checks

-   check sample genotypes
-   Index contamination
-   Fluorescence intensity
-   Sex check
-   Intersample correlation
-   Check cell composition

### 2.1 Genotypes & Contamination

```{r genotypes}

#select the samples we have snp data for
snp_samples <- pDat_disc %>%
  filter(Sample_ID %in% colnames(snps_all)) %>%
  filter(!GEO_Dataset == "GSE103253")
dim(snp_samples) #297 samples (379-82)

snps <- snps_all [,snp_samples$Sample_ID]
all(snp_samples$Sample_ID == colnames(snps)) #T

genotypes <- call_genotypes(snps)

snp_samples <- snp_samples %>% mutate(Sample_Donors = enumerate_sample_donors(genotypes)) 
n_distinct(snp_samples$Sample_Donors) #290 (7 duplicates!)

#check which samples are being called the same genotype
check_snp_agreement(genotypes, colnames(snps), colnames(snps))
#GSM2674440, GSM2674492, and GSM2674493
#GSM2674469, GSM2674488, and GSM2674489
#GSM2674479, GSM2674490, and GSM2674491
#GSM2674494 and GSM2674495

#These are the technical replicate samples from GSE100197 (n=8)
pDat_disc %>% filter(Condition == "Replicate")
#Note that GSM2674494 and GSM2674495 are PM72 (47XX+13 case, eoPRED score=0.3)

```

```{r contamination}

#use ewastools functions
snp_samples <- snp_samples %>% 
  mutate(prob_snp_outlier = colMeans(genotypes$outliers, na.rm = T),
         prob_snp_outlier_logodds = snp_outliers(genotypes))

snp_samples %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Sample_ID, y=prob_snp_outlier, color=GEO_Dataset)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position ="right")+
  labs(x="Sample ID", y="Probability of contamination")+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept =0.2, linetype=2)+
  geom_text_repel(data=(snp_samples %>% filter(prob_snp_outlier >0.2)),
                  aes(x=Sample_ID, y=prob_snp_outlier, label=Sample_ID))

snp_samples %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Sample_ID, y=prob_snp_outlier_logodds, color=GEO_Dataset)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position ="none")+
  labs(x="Sample ID", y="LO Probability of contamination")+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept =-4, linetype=2)+
  geom_text_repel(data=(snp_samples %>% filter(prob_snp_outlier_logodds >-4)),
                  aes(x=Sample_ID, y=prob_snp_outlier_logodds, label=Sample_ID))

table(snp_samples$prob_snp_outlier_logodds >-4) #32 samples!

snp_samples <- snp_samples %>% mutate(Failed_contam = ifelse(prob_snp_outlier_logodds >-4,T,F))
snp_samples <- snp_samples %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID, prob_snp_outlier, prob_snp_outlier_logodds, Failed_contam)

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% left_join(snp_samples, by="Sample_ID")

```

### 2.2 Fluorescence Intensity

```{r fluorescence}

#in the next step I am pulling tables of meth/unmeth fluo intensities per probe (rows) for every sample
meth <- getMeth(mset)
unmeth <- getUnmeth(mset)

intensity<- data.frame(
  Sample_ID = c(colnames(meth)),
  log2_median_meth = log2(colMedians(meth)), 
  log2_median_unmeth = log2(colMedians(unmeth)),
  mean_totalfluo = colMeans(meth+unmeth)) #total fluorescence = meth + unmeth

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% left_join(intensity, by="Sample_ID")

#plot meth vs. unmeth (Illumina suggested plot and threshold)
pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2_median_meth, y=log2_median_unmeth, color=GEO_Dataset))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_abline(intercept = 10.5*2, slope = -1, col = 'black', linetype = 'dashed')+ #illumina guidelines
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(7.5,15), ylim=c(7.5,15))+
  theme(legend.position="right")+
  geom_text_repel(data=(pDat_disc %>% filter(log2_median_unmeth<11 &
                                               log2_median_meth <10)),
                  aes(x=log2_median_meth, y=log2_median_unmeth, label=Sample_ID))

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% mutate(Failed_intensity = ifelse(log2_median_unmeth<11.1 &
                                               log2_median_meth <10.1, T,F))

#total intensity
upper_fluo <- mean(pDat_disc$mean_totalfluo) + 2*sd(pDat_disc$mean_totalfluo)
lower_fluo <- mean(pDat_disc$mean_totalfluo) - 2*sd(pDat_disc$mean_totalfluo)

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Sample_ID, y=mean_totalfluo, color=GEO_Dataset))+
  geom_point()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position="right")+
  labs(x="Sample ID")+
  # geom_label_repel (data = pDat_disc %>%
  #                   filter(mean_totalfluo < lower_fluo),
  #                   aes(x=Sample_ID, y=mean_totalfluo, label=Sample_ID),
  #                   show.legend = FALSE,
  #                   min.segment.length = 0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_fluo, col = 'black', linetype = 'dashed')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_fluo, col = 'black', linetype = 'dashed')

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% mutate(Failed_totalintensity = ifelse(mean_totalfluo < lower_fluo,T,F))
table(pDat_disc$Failed_totalintensity) #9 samples

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=GEO_Dataset, y=mean_totalfluo, color=GEO_Dataset))+
  geom_point(position=position_jitterdodge())+
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.5)+
  labs(x="GEO Dataset")+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_fluo, col = 'black', linetype = 'dashed')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_fluo, col = 'black', linetype = 'dashed')

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Row, y=mean_totalfluo, color=Row))+
  geom_point(position=position_jitterdodge())+
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.5)+
  labs(x="Row")+
  theme(legend.position="none")+

```

### 2.3 Sex-Check

```{r sex-check}

## Sex check - modified ewastools method
# compute total XY and auto probe intensities (meth + unmeth) per sample/column
chrX <- colMeans(meth[rownames(meth) %in% chrXprobes$probeID,] + unmeth[rownames(unmeth) %in% chrXprobes$probeID,])
chrY <- colMeans(meth[rownames(meth) %in% chrYprobes$probeID,] + unmeth[rownames(unmeth) %in% chrYprobes$probeID,])
auto <- colMeans(meth[rownames(meth) %in% autoProbes$probeID,] + unmeth[rownames(unmeth) %in% autoProbes$probeID,])

# normalize XY to total auto intensity
chrX <- chrX/auto
chrY <- chrY/auto

# add sex chr intensities to pDat 
pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% mutate(chrX_nInt = chrX,
                        chrY_nInt = chrY)

female <- pDat_disc$Sex %in% c("Female")
male <- pDat_disc$Sex %in% c("Male")

# compute robust Hodges-Lehmann estimator for total intensities of XY probes
X_int <- outer(pDat_disc$chrX_nInt[male], pDat_disc$chrX_nInt[female], "+") 
X_int <- median(X_int, all())/2 #X chromosome intensity cutoff

Y_int <- outer(pDat_disc$chrY_nInt[male], pDat_disc$chrY_nInt[female], "+") 
Y_int <- median(X_int, all())/2 #Y chromosome intensity cutoff

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% 
  mutate(DNAme_Sex = case_when(
  chrX_nInt>=X_int & chrY_nInt<=Y_int~"XX",
  chrX_nInt<=X_int & chrY_nInt>=Y_int~"XY",
  .default = "NA"))

table(pDat_disc$Sex, pDat_disc$DNAme_Sex) #1 mismatch

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% mutate(Sex_mismatch = ifelse(Sex =="Female" & DNAme_Sex =="XY",T,F))

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=chrX_nInt, y=chrY_nInt, color=Sex)) + 
  geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.4) +
  labs(title="Normalized X and Y Chr Fluorescence Intensity \nColoured by Reported Sex",
       y="Mean chrY/mean Autosomal Intensity",
       x="Mean chrX/mean Autosomal Intensity",
       color="Reported Sex") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title= element_text(hjust=0.5), legend.position="right")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#5647B2","#47B25E"),labels = c("XX","XY"))+
  geom_label_repel (data = pDat_disc %>%
                    filter(Sex_mismatch | Sample_ID == "GSM1944944"),
                    aes(chrX_nInt,chrY_nInt, label=Sample_ID),
                    show.legend = FALSE,
                    min.segment.length = 0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = Y_int)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = X_int)

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=chrX_nInt, y=chrY_nInt, color=GEO_Dataset)) + 
  geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.4) +
  labs(title="Normalized X and Y Chr Fluorescence Intensity \nColoured by Reported Sex",
       y="Mean chrY/mean Autosomal Intensity",
       x="Mean chrX/mean Autosomal Intensity",
       color="Dataset") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title= element_text(hjust=0.5), legend.position="right")+
  geom_label_repel (data = pDat_disc %>%
                    filter(Sex_mismatch | Sample_ID == "GSM1944944"),
                    aes(chrX_nInt,chrY_nInt, label=Sample_ID),
                    show.legend = FALSE,
                    min.segment.length = 0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = Y_int)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = X_int)

#Iciar also caught GSM2759051 and observed that GSM1944944 had irregular XIST methylation
#I see that it has slightly lower XIST methylation than other XY samples

## Sex check with XIST probes mean methylation
betas_raw <- getBeta(mset)

#select xist probes differentially methylated by sex
xist_probes <- chrXprobes %>% filter(probeID %in% c("cg03554089", "cg05533223", "cg11717280", "cg12653510", "cg20698282", "cg03862022", "cg23828566"))
dim(xist_probes) #5
betas_xist<- colMeans(betas_raw[rownames(betas_raw) %in% xist_probes$probeID, ])
pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% mutate(mean_beta_xist = betas_xist)

# plot sex chromosome intensity vs XIST beta values
pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(y=mean_beta_xist, x=chrX_nInt, color=Sex)) + 
  geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=X_int) +
  labs(title="Normalized X Intensity vs. Mean XIST DNAme",
       y="Mean XIST Beta",
       x="Normalized chrX/mean Autosomal Intensity",
       color="Reported Sex") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title= element_text(hjust=0.5))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#5647B2","#47B25E"),labels = c("XX","XY"))+
  geom_label_repel (data = pDat_disc %>%
                    filter(Sex_mismatch |Sample_ID == "GSM1944944"|
                             mean_beta_xist<0.75 & mean_beta_xist>0.65),
                    aes(y=mean_beta_xist, x=chrX_nInt, label=Sample_ID),
                    show.legend = FALSE,
                    min.segment.length = 0)

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(y=mean_beta_xist, x=chrX_nInt, color=GEO_Dataset)) + 
  geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=X_int) +
  labs(title="Normalized X Intensity vs. Mean XIST DNAme",
       y="Mean XIST Beta",
       x="Normalized chrX/mean Autosomal Intensity",
       color="Dataset") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title= element_text(hjust=0.5))+
  geom_label_repel (data = pDat_disc %>%
                    filter(Sex_mismatch | Sample_ID == "GSM1944944"|
                             mean_beta_xist<0.75 & mean_beta_xist>0.65|
                             chrX_nInt <1.01 & chrX_nInt>0.9),
                    aes(y=mean_beta_xist, x=chrX_nInt, label=Sample_ID),
                    show.legend = FALSE,
                    min.segment.length = 0)

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(y=mean_beta_xist, x=chrY_nInt, color=Sex)) + 
  geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=Y_int) +
  labs(title="Normalized Y Intensity vs. Mean XIST DNAme",
       y="Mean XIST Beta",
       x="Normalized chrY/mean Autosomal Intensity",
       color="Reported Sex") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title= element_text(hjust=0.5))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#5647B2","#47B25E"),labels = c("XX","XY"))+
  geom_label_repel (data = pDat_disc %>%
                    filter(Sex_mismatch | Sample_ID == "GSM1944944"|
                             mean_beta_xist<0.75 & mean_beta_xist>0.65),
                    aes(y=mean_beta_xist, x=chrY_nInt, label=Sample_ID),
                    show.legend = FALSE,
                    min.segment.length = 0)

#reduce memory space by removing large objects
remove(meth)
remove(unmeth)

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>%
  mutate(Failed_sex = ifelse(Sex_mismatch, TRUE, ifelse(Sample_ID %in% c(
    "GSM1944944","GSM2759051","GSM1892060","GSM1892055","GSM1892047","GSM1892059",
    "GSM1892052","GSM1892053","GSM1892051","GSM1892058"), TRUE, FALSE)))

table(pDat_disc$Failed_sex)

```

### 2.4 Intersample Correlation

```{r inter-sample-cor}

#calculate the correlation between the samples before normalization
cor_betas <- cor(na.omit(betas_raw))

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% mutate(med_IntersampleCorr_Beta_raw = colMedians(cor_betas))

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Sample_ID, y=med_IntersampleCorr_Beta_raw, fill=GEO_Dataset)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, color="darkgrey")+
  labs(title="Median Intersample Correlation (all Beta values)",
       x = "Sample ID") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position="none")+
  geom_label_repel(data=(pDat_disc %>%
                           filter(med_IntersampleCorr_Beta_raw <0.951)),
                   aes(x=Sample_ID, y=med_IntersampleCorr_Beta_raw, label=Sample_ID),
                   nudge_x=0.3)

pDat_disc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=GEO_Dataset, y=med_IntersampleCorr_Beta_raw, fill=GEO_Dataset)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2.5, position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, color="darkgrey")+
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.25, outlier.shape=NA)+
  labs(title="Median Intersample Correlation (all Beta values)",
       x = "Dataset") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position="none")

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% mutate(Failed_correlation = ifelse(med_IntersampleCorr_Beta_raw<0.951,T,F))

```



### 2.6 Cell composition

```{r cell-comp}

betas_bmiq <- wateRmelon::BMIQ(mset) #bmiq normalize for PlaNET
all.equal(colnames(betas_bmiq),pDat_disc$Sample_ID) #T

saveRDS(betas_bmiq, here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/betas_bmiq.RDS"))

data(plCellCpGsThird)

epidish_RPC <- epidish(
    beta.m = betas_bmiq[rownames(plCellCpGsThird), ],
    ref.m = plCellCpGsThird,
    method = "RPC"
)

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>%
  left_join(epidish_RPC$estF %>% 
              as.data.frame() %>%
              rownames_to_column(., var="Sample_ID"))%>%
  mutate(CTB_STB = Trophoblasts/Syncytiotrophoblast) 

pDat_disc %>% 
  mutate(Sample_order = as.factor(Syncytiotrophoblast))%>%
  dplyr::rename(CTB = Trophoblasts,
                STB = Syncytiotrophoblast) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(CTB,
                      STB,
                      Hofbauer,
                      Endothelial,
                      nRBC,
                      Stromal),
               names_to = "Cell_Type", values_to="Estimate") %>%
  mutate(Cell_Type = factor(Cell_Type,
                            levels=c("nRBC", "Endothelial", "Hofbauer",
                                     "Stromal", "CTB", "STB"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Sample_order, y=Estimate, color=Cell_Type, fill=Cell_Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-0.1,1.1))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim= c(0,1)) +  # tighten limits of plot
  labs(x="Sample",
       color = "Cell-type",
       fill = "Cell-type",
       title = "PlaNET Cell Estimates") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("grey","#6A1B9A","#1565C0","#388E3C","#FBC02D","#F4702E"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey","#6A1B9A","#1565C0","#388E3C","#FBC02D","#F4702E"))+
  theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom")

```

predictPreeclampsia <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/eoPRED_function.RDS"))

eoPRED_results <- predictPreeclampsia(t_betas_bmiq)

pDat_disc <- pDat_disc %>% left_join(eoPRED_results, by="Sample_ID")

### 2.8 Sample Filtering

-   Remove replicates (n=8)
-   Remove mismatched sex (n=3)
-   Below 2 SD on total intensity (n=8)
-   Irregular X/Y fluorescence or XIST methylation (n=4)
-   Intersample correlation <0.95 (n=2) - they also all had high contamination

```{r sample-filtering}

#are there samples that failed multiple of the QC checks?
table(pDat_disc$Failed_contam, pDat_disc$Failed_correlation) #5
table(pDat_disc$Failed_intensity, pDat_disc$Failed_totalintensity) #9 total

dim(pDat_disc) #379
pDat_filt <- pDat_disc %>%
  filter(!Condition == "Replicate"&
           !Sex_mismatch == TRUE &
           !Failed_sex == TRUE &
           !Failed_totalintensity == TRUE &
           !Failed_correlation)

dim(pDat_filt) #354 samples after QC
mset_filt <- mset[,pDat_filt$Sample_ID]
dim(mset_filt) #485512 x 354

table(pDat_disc$GEO_Dataset)
table(pDat_filt$GEO_Dataset)
table(pDat_filt$GEO_Dataset, pDat_filt$Condition)


```

## 3.0 Normalization


```{r adj-das}

ann <- data.frame(getAnnotation(mset_filt), stringsAsFactors = F)
ann$DESIGN <- ann$Type
dim(ann) #485512 x 34

#we need to create a methylumiset object using the annotation
mlumi_raw <- as.methylumi (mn = getMeth(mset_filt),
                           un = getUnmeth(mset_filt),
                           bn = getBeta(mset_filt),
                           pv = NULL,
                           qc = NULL,
                           da = ann)
class(mlumi_raw) #MethyLumiSet


betas_adjdas <- wateRmelon::adjustedDasen(mns = methylated(mlumi_raw),
                                          uns = unmethylated(mlumi_raw),
                                          onetwo = fData(mlumi_raw)[,fot(mlumi_raw)],
                                          chr = fData(mlumi_raw)$chr)

dim(betas_adjdas)
class(betas_adjdas) #data.frame
betas_adjdas[1:3,1:3]
sum(is.na(betas_adjdas))

```

## 4.0 Probe Filtering

-   genotyping (SNP probes already removed)
-   polymorphic and cross-hybridizing probes
-   poor quality probes (detection p-value> 0.01 in >=5% of samples, Y chromosome evaluated in males only)
-   additional poor X chr probes identified by Inkster et al. 2023 (Who's Afraid of the X)

### 4.1 Polymorphic & Cross-hybridizing

With 450k the best resource for this step is the [annotation](https://zwdzwd.github.io/InfiniumAnnotation) from the Zhou et al. team.

Based on how their annotation is structured they have a single column that removes both polymorphic and cross-hybridizing probes at the same time. This is captured in the `MASK_general` column.

```{r read-in-zhou-objects}

# read in the zhou annotation object (downloaded from their github website)
zhouAnno <- read.delim("//fs/teams/RobinsonLab/Hannah/01_Rotation & Maternal Age Project/C. Maternal Age Project/00_Data/HM450.hg38.mask.tsv.gz")
dim(zhouAnno) #485577

zhou_maskgeneral <- zhouAnno %>% filter(zhouAnno$MASK_general)
dim(zhou_maskgeneral) #64144 probes removed with MASK_general

# now let's actually remove those probes
dim(betas_adjdas) #485512 
betas_adjdas_filt <- betas_adjdas[!(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% zhou_maskgeneral$probeID), ]
dim(betas_adjdas_filt) #421368 

```

### 4.2 DetP

```{r bad-probes}

#load the detP matrix
detp_all <- readRDS(paste0(iciar_data_path,"detp.RDS"))
dim(detp_all) #485512 x 401

detp <- detp_all [,pDat_filt$Sample_ID]
dim(detp)

# rather than actually sex-stratifying for the detP probes I am going to change 
# all the female Y chromosome values to 0 so that they aren't considered for detP removal 
pDat_f <- pDat_filt %>% filter(Sex == "Female")

f_detP <- detp #make an object where we will modifty the detP value in females 
f_detP[rownames(f_detP) %in% chrYprobes$probeID, colnames(f_detP) %in% pDat_f$Sample_ID] <- 0
femaleYdetP <- f_detP[rownames(f_detP) %in% chrYprobes$probeID, colnames(f_detP) %in% pDat_f$Sample_ID]
all(femaleYdetP == 0) #check this step worked
dim(femaleYdetP)
failed_detP <- f_detP > 0.01 #get a matrix of how many probes failed detP

betas_raw <- betas_raw[,pDat_filt$Sample_ID]

# create an logical matrix with which probes failed a check (true = fail)
# sum to see if a probe failed any checks (false + false = 0)
failed_probes <- failed_detP + is.na(betas_raw) 
failed_probes <- failed_probes > 0 # >0 means failed any of the checks

table(rowSums(failed_probes) >= (ncol(failed_probes)*0.05)) #626 probes to remove

# index them for removal
badprobes <- data.frame(probebad <- rowSums(failed_probes) >= ncol(failed_probes)*0.05) %>%
  filter(probebad == TRUE)
dim(badprobes) #626

## Remove the probes from the betas object
table(row.names(betas_adjdas_filt) %in% rownames(badprobes))
betas_adjdas_filt <- betas_adjdas_filt[!(row.names(betas_adjdas_filt) %in% rownames(badprobes)),]
dim(betas_adjdas_filt) #421210

# Total number of probes that failed for each sample
Total_failed_probes <- colSums(failed_probes)
identical(names(Total_failed_probes), pDat_filt$Sample_ID) #check
pDat_filt <- pDat_filt %>% mutate(Total_failed_probes = Total_failed_probes) #add to sample sheet
summary(pDat_filt$Total_failed_probes)

pDat_filt %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Sample_ID, y=Total_failed_probes, fill=GEO_Dataset)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = nrow(failed_probes)*0.01, color="darkgrey")+
  labs(title="Total Failed Probes)",
       x = "Sample ID") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position="right")

# identify samples with > 1% failed detP probes
table(colSums(detp>0.01) > nrow(detp)*0.01) #none
table(colSums(failed_probes) > nrow(failed_probes)*0.01) #none

```

### 4.3 Additional X/Y Probes

Inkster et al. 2023 identified additional probes on the X and Y that should be removed from analysis because they overlapped with the XTR, repetitive elements, or were in cancer testis gene promoters. Here I will remove those probes.

```{r bad-x-y-probes}

#load additional X and Y annotation info
chrXY_ext <- read.csv("//fs/teams/RobinsonLab/Hannah/05_Projects/SPAH/B. Data/B. Reference Data/Inkster_extended_XY_probe_annotation.csv",header = T, fileEncoding="UTF-8-BOM")

bad_xy_probes <- chrXY_ext %>% filter(MASK_X_transposed_region == TRUE |
                                        MASK_AnyRepetitive == TRUE)
dim(bad_xy_probes) #726

table(rownames(betas_adjdas_filt) %in% bad_xy_probes$probeID) #520

#remove probes
betas_adjdas_filt <- betas_adjdas_filt [!(rownames(betas_adjdas_filt) %in% bad_xy_probes$probeID),]
dim(betas_adjdas_filt) #420690 probes

table(rownames(betas_adjdas_filt) %in% autoProbes$probeID) #411254
table(rownames(betas_adjdas_filt) %in% chrXprobes$probeID) #9210
table(rownames(betas_adjdas_filt) %in% chrYprobes$probeID) #226

```

## 5.0 Save Objects & Conclusion

We ended up with 354 placentas and 420,381 probes (n=8895 chrX, n=226 chrY). In the CNV script I checked for CNVs using conumee and removed two additional samples. In the next scripts I will perform PCA, look for associations with sex in this dataset, and look for DNAme on the X and Y associated with eoPRED score.  

```{r save}

saveRDS(pDat_disc, here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/pDat_disc.RDS"))
saveRDS(pDat_filt, here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/pDat_filt.RDS"))
saveRDS(betas_adjdas, here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/betas_adjdas.RDS"))
saveRDS(betas_adjdas_filt, here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/betas_adjdas_filt.RDS"))

```
